mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id,u.user_name,u.dept_id,u.auth_revision,u.status,u.del_flag,u.nick_name,u.avatar,u.user_type, r.role_id,r.role_name,r.role_key,r.role_sort,r.data_scope,r.kind,r.factory_id, r.status AS role_status,r.del_flag AS role_del_flag FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' WHERE u.user_id=#{userId}
SELECT auth_revision FROM sys_user WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT user_id,auth_revision AS revision,0 AS attempts FROM sys_user WHERE user_id IN #{id}
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_name=#{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_session_revocation(user_id,revision) SELECT user_id,auth_revision FROM sys_user WHERE user_id IN #{id} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempts=CASE WHEN VALUES(revision)>revision THEN 0 ELSE attempts END, last_attempt=CASE WHEN VALUES(revision)>revision THEN NULL ELSE last_attempt END, last_error=CASE WHEN VALUES(revision)>revision THEN NULL ELSE last_error END, next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN VALUES(revision)>revision THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE next_attempt_at END, revision=GREATEST(revision,VALUES(revision))
mapper.select: SELECT user_id,revision,attempts FROM sys_session_revocation WHERE next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_attempt_at,user_id LIMIT 100
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_session_revocation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revision=#{revision}
